content:
sarah_partners: Datadog asked if we can do a live observability demo at their booth two weeks out. They want OTLP traces, a dashboard tile showing GPU metrics + token throughput, and a 30s social clip. Can we commit?
mike_eng: doable if we scope to a single demo app. We need to add model metadata and cache hit flags to spans. I can ship a small change.
anna_pm: marketing wants an embargoed blurb 5 days before the show. I'll draft. Need an ENG quote from Matt.
jess_ops: infra: prefer we run on our staging dedicated pool so their engineers can validate ingestion. Keys must be demo-only and rotated after. I'll handle key gating.
oliver_docs: I'll prepare a one-file reproducible demo (docker-compose) + a short runbook and the clip checklist. Mike, can you paste the OTLP snippet for docs?
mike_eng: OTLP snippet for docs: exporters.otlp.endpoint=https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317; headers=DD-API-KEY:<REDACTED>. We'll add span attrs: model.name, model.version, cache.hit.
eric_dd: Datadog wants two trace examples: cold-start and cached-run, to show waterfall differences. Also a small co-branded slide.
sarah_partners: timeline: today lock scope; +2d infra + traces; +4d docs + clip draft + quote; +6d partner review/legal; +8d demo day. Owners: mike_eng infra/traces; oliver_docs artifacts/clip; jess_ops keys/legal; anna_pm quote & partner liaison; sarah_partners booth ops.
mike_eng: opening branch dd-live-obsv-demo and will push trace captures (100% sampling) and PR.
jess_ops: deploy-bot scheduled deploy to demo-staging at 2021-07-15T14:32Z. I'll follow up with legal.
sarah_partners: locking scope unless objections. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
